[Unit]
Description=Stillyard attached Windows/WSL scheduler

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/python3 "/home/pythonic/.local/share/stillyard/libexec/wsl-service.py" delegate --executors "/sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/user-1000.slice/user@1000.service/app.slice/stillyard.service/executors" --ram-mb 16384
ExecStart="/home/pythonic/.local/share/stillyard/bin/stillyard" daemon
WorkingDirectory="/home/pythonic/.local/share/stillyard"
Delegate=cpu memory pids
DelegateSubgroup=manager
Slice=app.slice
KillMode=process
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
UMask=0077
UnsetEnvironment=STILLYARD_STORE STILLYARD_ENDPOINT STILLYARD_JOB_ID STILLYARD_ATTEMPT STILLYARD_INVOCATION_ID STILLYARD_ROLE

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
